summary: AITS 'Saare din ek saath' insights tested on the isolated bridge (127.0.0.1:8777, frozen day 6). Backend: 7/7 pytest pass. Insights numbers match expect for hero and peer, no session gives 401, and each student sees only their own days. Frontend: 108/119 Playwright checks pass on desktop 1920 and mobile 390 for hero and peer. Every listed feature renders with correct data. One functional bug: each of the four non-analysis day-page buttons (Progress, Confidence, Rank, Solutions) adds TWO history entries, so one browser Back stays on /results and you need two. Merely focusing a tab (keyboard Tab key) also navigates away. Remaining failures are cosmetic or testability issues.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking series-day-view-progress/accuracy/rank/solutions pushes /results/{id}?view=X twice (history.length 3->5). One browser Back stays on the results page; a second Back is needed to return to the day page. Focusing a tab without clicking (keyboard Tab) also opens /results (history 5->6). RCA: Radix Tabs default activationMode='automatic' calls onValueChange on mousedown AND on focus. Because value is fixed at 'analysis', the trigger never becomes selected, so both calls navigate. Fix: <Tabs activationMode="manual" ...> or guard go() with a ref. The normal Results page tabs (Results.js result-view-*) have the same pre-existing double push (history 2->4 on one tab click). Consider activationMode='manual' there too.

Duplicate data-testids: 'Average marks' and 'Average se upar' both produce si-overall-average. On the day card, 'Average' and 'Average se' both produce si-day-vs-average. Cause: testid built from l.split(' ')[0]. Use explicit keys, e.g. si-overall-above / si-day-vs-gap.

issues: Cosmetic: .si-label-note is grey (rgb 94,94,105) but the same 12px as the h2 on mobile, so it is not visibly smaller. Section titles like 'SUBJECT-WISE TREND' and 'BAR-BAR GALAT HONE WALE CHAPTER' wrap to two lines beside a two-line note.
Cosmetic: the label 'Average se' with value '-15' reads incomplete. Consider 'Average se farak' or 'vs Average'.

action_items: Fix the double navigation in DayDestinations: add activationMode="manual" to <Tabs> in DayTools.js (or a once-guard) so one Back from /results?view=X returns to the day page and keyboard focus does not navigate. Consider the same for the result-view tabs in Results.js.
Make the duplicate testids si-overall-average and si-day-vs-average unique (cosmetic/testability).
critical_code_review_comments: DayTools.js: a controlled Radix Tabs used as a navigator must use activationMode='manual'. Otherwise onValueChange fires on focus and on mousedown (root cause of the HIGH bug).
Overall.js / VsClass.js: testids derived from the first word of the label collide.
Overall.js: the max shown for Average and Best is data.days[0].maximum. If papers ever differ in maximum this is wrong (minor).

series_insights.py: the class cache (_class) is per process and lasts 5 min, so a day's average/topper can lag by up to 5 min after release. Acceptable but worth noting. Read-only queries, no _id leaks, auth via current.

success_rate.frontend: 91% (108/119; 8 failures = the one double-Back bug x4 destinations x2 sizes, plus 2 duplicate-testid and 1 cosmetic note-size)

seed_data_creation: None. Only the bridge's throw-away DB was used; the preview DB was never written to.

rca of the issue: Repro: open /series/all-india-jee/analysis/{hero day3}, click series-day-view-progress, press browser Back. The URL is still /results/{id}?view=progress (history.length went 3->5). A second Back returns to the day page. Root cause: Radix TabsTrigger fires onValueChange on onMouseDown and again on onFocus (automatic activation, trigger not selected because value is pinned to 'analysis'). DayDestinations.go navigates on each call. Mitigation: activationMode='manual' on the Tabs.
